A.claim: The abc conjecture implies only that there are FINITELY MANY counterexamples to Beal, not that there are none; and the finiteness is ineffective. Therefore no route through abc - including inter-universal Teichmuller theory - can resolve Beal.

B.claim: The congruence conditions at coprime moduli are positively CORRELATED as constraints, not independent: f(m1*m2) < f(m1)*f(m2) in every measured case, with ratios 0.749-0.889 for two factors and 0.500-0.560 for three.
